component.name: Cone Player
component.summary: Play videos and music with a modern interface

description.p: Cone Player is a media player for your videos and music. It plays almost any file and stream with the engine of VLC media player, and wraps it in a calm, modern interface: the "VLC Redesign" by the designer Juxtopposed, built for real.

ul.li: A thin control bar and a top bar that float over the video and get out of the way
One sidebar for subtitles, audio, video and playback settings, with presets per show
Subtitles from files or OpenSubtitles, with a timeline and automatic sync
Bookmarks, chapters and a queue in one place
A media library with Continue Watching, music, playlists and network streams
Dark and light themes with an accent color of your choice

description.p: Interface design: "VLC Redesign" by Juxtopposed, under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license. Engine: VLC media player by VideoLAN and its contributors.

Experimental: Cone Player follows the development version of VLC media player (VLC 4). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by VideoLAN or Juxtopposed; VLC is a trademark of the VideoLAN non-profit organization.

screenshot.caption: Your video, with the controls floating over it
Playback, video, audio and subtitle settings in one sidebar
Subtitle tracks from the file or from your computer
Open files, folders, discs and network streams

ul.li: No more freeze when you drag the playback speed slider
The mouse pointer hides again over a playing video, in a window and in fullscreen, and stays visible while paused
Up Next for shows: the next episode card comes when the credits start
Files opened from the file manager play in the window that is already open
Cone Player shows with its own name and icon in the dock, the media controls and the sound mixer
Hardware video decoding finds the drivers on more distributions
